name: @digitaplatform/usermenu
description: Digita first-party FREE plugin: role-scoped navigation rail. Reads the UserMenu entity via the engine's generic resource API and builds + role-gates the tree client-side (the engine knows nothing about navigation). BUILT-IN: the ui compiles this SOURCE directly into its own module graph (one Vite graph, one React) and registers it at boot via packages/ui/src/plugins/builtins.ts — no vite bundle, no runtime load, no staging.
